c2bSeriesModelRecommendation.rejectedOfficialAvailabilityEnum: Do not implement official_availability = global/india_only/not_offered/unresolved as a DB enum. Official availability can depend on country, zone, centre, edition, and series. No authoritative eligibility model exists.

rejected: Year-span-only is insufficient: Cambridge issues version N updates for the same examination-year range (e.g. 9709 2026–2027 version 4; 9231 2026–2027 version 3; 9609/9708 2026–2028 version 2; 9618 2026 version 2; 9489 2026 version 3).
Images publication id alone (e.g. 718292) is useful provenance but may be a CMS asset id, not a syllabus revision code printed as a stable product key.
notes: Official syllabus Version N is printed on the Cambridge PDF.

externalProvenance.note: Official Cambridge edition, Images id, Version N, and series facts stay in this artifact. Internal identity readiness is not external edition certainty.
